# ScanLine <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
ScanLine:Int32
```

**Returns:** Always 0. The original returned the line the monitor was drawing, which a modern display cannot tell.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* Always returns 0. Use `VWait` or `Flip` to synchronise with the display instead.
